signals.signal: UNRESOLVED SPLIT NOW RESOLVED. The bank's own live network-locator JSON feed (pulled 30/07/2026) returns 2,069 places: 263 branches and 1,806 self-service devices. Raiffeisen-branded own fleet = 548 'Bancomat' cash-out ATMs + 603 'Bancomat multifunctional EUR' + 60 'Smart Cashbox' multi-currency corporate deposit units = 1,211 devices. On top sit 595 Euronet-branded devices displayed inside the customer network (414 cash-out ATMs + 181 'Bancomat multifunctional' RON-deposit units).
signals.source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Romania - network locator API (map.maps.viewport.json)
signals.implies: The 'ATM vs MFM' ambiguity carried since the last run is settled: 548 pure cash-out + 603 multifunctional own units. The 962 total cash-out figure only holds if Euronet partner devices are counted. Recycler/deposit automation is already the majority of the OWN estate, so Printec's angle is refresh/replacement and the Euronet-adjacent white space, not greenfield deposit automation.
signals.likelihood: Fleet refresh decisions likely to surface alongside the Garanti integration in 2027
signals.followup: Identify the OEM behind the 603 multifunctional units and the 60 Smart Cashbox units - still unnamed anywhere public

signals.signal: Within the 603 'Bancomat multifunctional EUR' units, only 404 advertise EUR cash withdrawal; 130 dispense RON only; 534 advertise RON+EUR deposit (06:00-23:30). 60 Smart Cashbox units accept RON/EUR/USD/GBP deposits for corporates only.
signals.source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Romania - network locator API (service attributes per device)
signals.implies: True dual-currency recycling covers roughly a third of the own estate. ~199 multifunctional units lack EUR dispensing and ~69 list no cash service at all - a concrete upgrade/retrofit target for cash-recycler modules and multi-currency cassettes.
signals.likelihood: Medium - upgrade cycle plausible within 12-24 months
signals.followup: Confirm whether the non-EUR-dispensing 130 units are older hardware or a deliberate product choice

signals.signal: Audited FY2025 annual report: 'Reteaua fizica ramane un pilon important: peste 588 de masini multifunctionale si 549 de ATM-uri... Solutiile Smart Cashbox pentru depuneri multivaluta, cu 61 de echipamente instalate la nivel national'. Acceptance: 27,000+ merchants on EPOS/RaiPOS/e-commerce generating over RON 16bn of receipts in 2025, +8% y/y; card acceptance contractable in-app from March 2025.
signals.implies: Audited confirmation of the split and of a growing acquiring book. 61 Smart Cashbox at YE2025 vs 60 live today - a small, discrete, replaceable multi-currency deposit estate that is the cleanest Printec cash-automation entry point.
signals.likelihood: High that Smart Cashbox estate expands with corporate cash volumes
signals.followup: Find the Smart Cashbox OEM and the contract renewal window

signals.signal: Management report at 31/12/2025: 266 banking units (6 fewer than a year earlier), 39,983 EPOS terminals, over 1,100 ATMs of which 587 MFM; client base over 2.4 million at group level.
signals.source_name: Raiffeisen Bank S.A. - Raportul Directoratului la 31.12.2025 (PDF, bondholder disclosure)
signals.implies: Second primary source on the same estate (587 vs 588 MFM - a rounding/date difference, not a contradiction). 39,983 owned EPOS terminals is a large, concrete POS estate for terminal supply and managed POS services.
signals.likelihood: POS estate keeps growing with merchant acquisition
signals.followup: Determine EPOS terminal OEM mix and whether estate management sits with Euronet under the 2003 outsourcing

signals.signal: Q1-2026 results (04/05/2026): 264 branches, over 42,000 merchant POS terminals, 2.36m clients; voice-guidance for cash withdrawal at ATMs and MFMs 'extended nationally'; net profit RON 367m (-12% y/y); total assets near RON 90bn (+6%). Branch trend: 272 (18/06/2025) to 266 (31/12/2025) to 264 (31/03/2026) to 263 in the live locator (30/07/2026).
signals.source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Romania Q1-2026 results release filed at Bucharest Stock Exchange (PDF)
signals.implies: POS grew ~2,000 terminals in one quarter while branches shrank. Cash and service load keeps shifting onto self-service - supports recycler/self-service density and managed-services propositions.
signals.likelihood: Continued branch attrition and POS growth through 2026
signals.followup: Watch H1-2026 release (RBI group H1 not yet published as of 30/07/2026) for updated ATM/MFM counts

signals.signal: Cloud migration: '64% dintre aplicatiile Bancii fiind deja in Cloud' at end-2025, with the remainder in progress. Group context: RBI runs AWS and Microsoft Azure, targeting ~80% of technology assets in cloud by end-2025, with Hitachi Digital Services accelerating the programme across ~1,000 assessed applications.
signals.source_name: Raiffeisen Bank S.A. Raportul Directoratului 31.12.2025; Hitachi Digital Services RBI customer story
signals.implies: Any Printec software sale (AML, transaction monitoring, eKYC, HSM key management) must be cloud-native / AWS-Azure deployable and DORA-compliant. On-prem-only appliances will not clear architecture review.
signals.followup: Confirm which of AWS/Azure is primary for the Romanian entity and whether payments/card workloads are in scope

signals.signal: Accessibility under Law 232/2022 (transposing EU Directive 2019/882): voice-guided cash withdrawal rolled out on ATMs and MFMs, headsets and relief symbols, Braille cards from 15/05/2024, WCAG 2.1 AA website, VoiceOver support in Smart Mobile. However the bank's public locator exposes NO per-device accessibility attribute, so customers cannot identify which of the 1,806 displayed devices are voice-guided.
signals.source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Romania - Accesibilitate page; Q1-2026 results release
signals.implies: Law 232/2022 has applied since 28/06/2025; a service-provider transition runs to 28/06/2030 and self-service terminals in use before 28/06/2025 may run at most 20 years from commissioning. That is a hard, dated replacement driver across the estate and a lever for accessible self-service hardware plus per-device compliance reporting.
signals.followup: Establish which units are already EAA-compliant and how many pre-28/06/2025 terminals fall inside the 20-year cap; check for ANPC enforcement actions on banks

signals.signal: Competition Council plenum fined Raiffeisen Bank Romania RON 442.49m on 07/06/2026 in the ROBOR case (RON 3.73bn / ~EUR 710m across 10 banks: BT 875.74m, BCR 577.36m, Raiffeisen 442.49m, UniCredit 431.03m, BRD 412.47m, ING 405.91m, CEC 332.98m, Exim 96.49m, Libra 45.86m, Intesa 28.1m). Banks have 60 days from the reasoned decision to submit remediation plans and 30 days to appeal to the Court of Appeal. Raiffeisen publicly disputes the findings and will litigate.
signals.source_name: Wall-street.ro / Profit.ro reporting on the Competition Council decision
signals.implies: The fine exceeds Q1-2026 net profit (RON 367m). If provisioned, it compresses 2026-2027 discretionary technology capex exactly while the Garanti integration is being funded - argues for opex/managed-service and as-a-service commercial structures rather than capex hardware deals.
signals.followup: Check the H1-2026 accounts for the provision booked and whether the appeal suspends payment; get the CC reasoned decision when published

signals.entity: Raiffeisen Bank Romania / Garanti BBVA Romania
signals.signal: Raiffeisen agreed on 28/03/2026 to buy 100% of Garanti Bank S.A., Motoractive IFN S.A. and Motoractive Multiservices S.R.L. for EUR 591m. BBVA states the Romanian unit is the 10th largest institution in Romania, ~2% market share, EUR 4bn total assets at end-2025, and the sale gives BBVA ~+10bp CET1 and EUR 112m P&L. Garanti Bank operated through its Bucharest head office and 71 agencies at 31/12/2024 (71 also at 31/12/2023). Competition Council opened its review on 15/06/2026; closing expected Q4-2026; gradual integration to complete in H2-2027.
signals.source_name: BBVA press release; Garanti Bank S.A. IFRS financial statements 31/12/2024; Consiliul Concurentei communique via juridice.ro
signals.implies: A 71-branch, dual-fleet harmonisation exercise running through H2-2027: two ATM/MFM estates, two POS acquiring books, two card/AML/onboarding stacks to converge. Historically the single richest Printec entry point in a CEE bank integration - migration, estate harmonisation, decommissioning and managed services.
signals.followup: Get Garanti BBVA RO's current ATM/POS counts and OEM; identify the integration programme owner at Raiffeisen; track the Competition Council decision and BNR shareholder approval

signals.signal: RoPay gap: on the scheme's own participants page Raiffeisen Bank is listed with only 'RoPay Alias - Payment' (send money by phone number). Peers CEC Bank, Libra, ING, BCR, Banca Transilvania, Vista and Salt already offer the fuller set including QR at POS, displayed/Business QR, invoices and e-commerce. RoPay 2.0 took effect 01/09/2025 and press lists Raiffeisen (with UniCredit) as still 'in implementation'. Raiffeisen joined RoPay for P2P on 21/10/2025.
signals.source_name: RoPay (TRANSFOND) participants page; Wall-street.ro on RoPay 2.0 rollout
signals.implies: A bank with 39,983+ EPOS terminals and 27,000+ merchants has no merchant-side RoPay acceptance live. That is a concrete, dated gap in POS/acquiring capability - QR acceptance, terminal software, request-to-pay and merchant enablement.
signals.likelihood: High - competitive pressure forces P2B rollout within 6-12 months
signals.followup: Confirm Raiffeisen's RoPay P2B roadmap and whether terminal-side QR is handled by Euronet under the existing outsourcing

signals.signal: Digital onboarding / eKYC: in Q1-2026 the bank completed an API integration with the Directia Generala de Evidenta a Persoanelor (national population records) for identity verification, and holders of the Romanian electronic ID card can now update their data fully in-app. In 2025, 78% of new clients were onboarded digitally via Smart Mobile and remote enrolment rose 56% y/y in Q1-2026; 85% of retail clients active on Smart Mobile at end-2025.
signals.source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Romania Q1-2026 results release (BVB); Raport anual 2025
signals.implies: eKYC is already built in-house against a government API - a straight digital-onboarding product sale is largely closed off. The residual openings are downstream: AML screening, transaction monitoring and fraud analytics on the higher remote-onboarding volumes, plus in-branch/self-service identity capture for the Garanti migration.
signals.likelihood: AML/monitoring load grows with remote volumes
signals.followup: Identify the incumbent AML/transaction-monitoring vendor at Raiffeisen RO and at Garanti BBVA RO

signals.signal: Funding headroom: EUR 500m senior non-preferred MREL-eligible bond priced 20/01/2026 at 4.136% (mid-swap +162bp), Moody's Baa2 (one notch above sovereign Baa3), order book EUR 2.8bn final / EUR 3.3bn peak from 180+ investors - the 9th series under the EMTN programme, taking total capital-market funding to ~EUR 1.6bn.
signals.source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Romania press release - new euro-denominated bond series
signals.implies: Balance-sheet capacity exists to fund the EUR 591m Garanti purchase and the associated integration spend even with the ROBOR fine pending - so integration technology budgets are unlikely to be cancelled outright.
signals.followup: Watch for a further MREL issue in H2-2026 tied to the Garanti closing

signals.signal: Cashless branch model is complete: the FY2025 annual report states that for cash operations clients rely principally on the 24/7 ATM/MFM network plus 'cash box' type solutions for large corporate deposits, and that only 'un numar limitat de casierii dedicate' (a limited number of dedicated cash desks) has been retained, solely for collecting FX loan instalments in EUR/CHF/USD.
signals.implies: 100% of retail cash has been pushed to self-service, so device availability and cash-cycle efficiency are business-critical rather than convenience features. Strengthens the case for cash-forecasting/optimisation and availability-SLA managed services - and makes any Garanti branches inherited with staffed tellers an immediate conversion target.
signals.likelihood: Garanti branches converted to cashless during H2-2027 integration
signals.followup: Establish how many of Garanti's 71 agencies still run staffed cash desks

signals.signal: BNR payment-instrument statistics at 31/12/2025: 11,136 ATMs provided by resident payment service providers (+1,108 vs June 2025), 729,408 POS terminals (+161,396), 685,731 EFTPOS acceptance points (+120,300), 28.63m active cards of which 24.68m with cash-withdrawal function (+5.06% vs June 2025).
signals.source_name: Digi24 Economic reporting BNR payment statistics
signals.implies: Romania's ATM base is growing again after years of decline, and POS is expanding very fast. Raiffeisen's ~1,211 own devices are ~11% of the national ATM base; its 39,983 EPOS terminals are ~5.5% of national POS - under-indexed on POS relative to its ~9-11% asset share, i.e. acquiring is where it must chase share.
signals.followup: Pull the BNR interactive statistics database directly for the H1-2026 update rather than relying on press

coverage_notes: Fresh full run (no prior checkpoint existed for this runDate). Primary-first: (1) the bank's own network-locator JSON API, which nobody had opened before and which decisively resolves the ATM/MFM split the baseline flagged as unresolved; (2) the audited FY2025 Raport anual PDF and the 31/12/2025 Raportul Directoratului bondholder PDF, both downloaded and text-extracted locally with pdfminer; (3) the Q1-2026 results PDF filed at the Bucharest Stock Exchange; (4) the bank's own accessibility page; (5) BBVA's own release and Garanti Bank S.A.'s audited IFRS 2024 statements for the target's size; (6) the RoPay scheme participants page. Angles deliberately varied vs previous runs: exchange filings (bvb.ro infocont), the bond/EMTN disclosure trail, the national instant-payment scheme register, the seller's (BBVA) IR, and a live product-locator API. Genuine gaps: (a) the OEM behind the 603 multifunctional units, the 60 Smart Cashbox units and the 39,983 EPOS terminals is still unnamed anywhere public - Euronet has run ATM+POS end-to-end since 24/09/2003 and no hardware brand is disclosed, so the standing 'name the incumbent' task remains open here; (b) RBI group H1-2026 was not published as of 30/07/2026, so no updated Romania segment data; (c) Garanti BBVA Romania's current ATM/POS counts are not published - only 71 agencies at 31/12/2024 is primary-sourced; (d) no ANPC or BNR enforcement action on ATM accessibility was found; (e) the Competition Council's reasoned ROBOR decision is not yet public, so the fine figure rests on press.
access_issues: consiliulconcurentei.ro is behind a JavaScript/anti-bot challenge: WebFetch returned HTTP 503 on both the Garanti merger communique and the archive item, and a curl retry with a desktop Chrome User-Agent plus ro-RO Accept-Language returned only 'Verifying your browser - Enable JavaScript and cookies to continue'. Logged and routed around via juridice.ro, which reproduces the official communique verbatim, and via wall-street.ro / profit.ro for the ROBOR decision. Blocked URLs: https://www.consiliulconcurentei.ro/comunicate/consiliul-concurentei-analizeaza-preluarea-garanti-bank-s-a-si-motoractive-ifn-s-a-de-catre-raiffeisen-bank-s-a/ and .../consiliul-concurentei-a-sanctionat-societatile-raiffeisen-bank-sa-si-raiffeisen-leasing-international-gesellschaft-mbh-pentru-omisiunea-notificarii-unei-concentrari-economice/ . bvb.ro/infocont/infocont26/RBRO26.html returned 404 (index path guess) but individual filing PDFs fetched fine. Garanti Bank's 2024 IFRS PDF carries a no-text-extraction metadata flag; extracted anyway with pdfminer (public audited filing). Nothing was silently dropped.
operator_requests: 1) Consiliul Concurentei reasoned decision in the ROBOR case (RON 442.49m against Raiffeisen Bank Romania, plenum 07/06/2026) once published - the site is JS-gated and needs a real browser session. 2) Consiliul Concurentei authorisation decision on the Raiffeisen/Garanti Bank/Motoractive concentration when issued (expected before the Q4-2026 closing), same access problem. 3) Garanti Bank S.A. audited IFRS financial statements and Pillar III report for 31/12/2025, if published on garantibbva.ro - needed for a current branch/ATM/employee count on the integration target. 4) RBI group H1-2026 interim report Romania segment, once released.
